description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kolaghan Stormsinger, adding {R}.
When Kolaghan Stormsinger dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Kolaghan Stormsinger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Kolaghan Stormsinger's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kolaghan Stormsinger triggers, giving a creature you control haste until end of turn.
Repeat.
